g.text: Thor SoC: CPU, GPU, and copy engines all funnel through ONE memory controller to one LPDDR pool
NVIDIA Jetson Thor T5000 (Blackwell, sm_110), MAXN, GPU clocks locked. Edge labels are measured rates [source tag]. Orin is the same topology (16 SM, 4 MB L2, 177 GB/s DRAM).
